top._headline: Chevron Duvernay Decision Window Opens September 4th — Act Now
top._insight: With Chevron Canada's Kaybob South mud program award falling squarely in the September 4–8 window and MI-SWACO already actively competing against incumbent Newpark, this is a live, contested opportunity at a high-value Duvernay well with confirmed medium data confidence — the strongest intelligence quality in this set. The 148°C bottomhole temperature demands a sophisticated high-performance invert emulsion system, a technical wedge where a challenger can differentiate sharply on thermal stability and wellbore quality data from comparable Duvernay offsets. Engage Chevron Canada's Kaybob drilling engineer immediately with a tailored HPHT fluid proposal and offset well performance benchmarks before the contract is verbally committed to either incumbent.
